name: dialog
title: Animated Dialog
description: A compact confirmation dialog with a heading, a warning paragraph and a bright primary button paired with an outlined cancel. It fades and slides in over a blurred dark page.
use: An action is destructive or costly and needs one clear stop before it runs.
avoid: Only two actions and a short body fit comfortably; the card has no internal scroll.
a11y: No dialog role, no focus trap or initial focus, and the X button has no accessible name. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small dark button labelled Delete project on a near-black page; opened, a rounded dark card floats over a black wash holding a heading, two lines of grey body text, a bright Confirm button and an outlined Cancel, with a small X at the top right.
behaves: Clicking the button fades the backdrop and slides the card up a little; the X, Cancel, a backdrop click or Escape closes it with the same fade.
customise: ModalContent wraps your own markup and open plus setOpen switch it between controlled and self-managed; width and blur are in the source.
weight: light: One overlay and one card with simple opacity and slide tweens.
demo: Heading "Confirm Action" with a delete warning and Confirm and Cancel buttons
issues: The close X has no label and the panel lacks a dialog role.
No focus is moved into the dialog, so keyboard users stay on the page behind.
polishWhy: Clean, restrained confirmation card; default borders and missing dialog semantics keep it ordinary.
